people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

translations.web: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
translations.bsb: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
translations.kjv: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
translations.asv: But show kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom thy brother.
